name: Sunyata

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Prajnaparamita realization which encompasses all phenomena without exception

VINIT.justification: The state before the emergence of subject-object distinction or linguistic labeling

TANCH.justification: The ultimate boundary that contains the totality of all possible appearances

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of causes and conditions giving rise to appearances

AREV.justification: The analytical reversal of appearances to reveal their lack of inherent existence

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of discrete moments into a perceived continuity

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity of the object is its own lack of independent identity

FSPLIT.justification: The split of unified reality into the duality of self and other

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of self and other into the original unified reality

EVALT.justification: The affirmative validation of phenomena as they appear to conventional mind

EVALF.justification: The negation of the inherent existence of those same phenomena

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of appearance and emptiness without contradiction

IFIX.justification: The permanent recording of an action within the storehouse consciousness

phase_3.void_description: The unconditioned state before the first movement of thought
phase_3.true_description: The conventional validity of cause and effect within the world
phase_3.false_description: The total absence of any permanent or independent essence
phase_3.both_description: The middle way where form is emptiness and emptiness is form

steps.domain_action: Establish the ground of unconditioned awareness
Recognize the ground as inherently empty of self-nature
Initiate the process of dependent origination
Chain causes and conditions to produce a phenomenal appearance
Divide the appearance into a perceiving subject and a perceived object
Validate the relative existence of the subject-object relationship
Record the interaction as a permanent karmic seed
Apply analytical meditation to the perceived object
Negate the independent existence of the object
Reintegrate the subject and object into a single field of experience
Hold the appearance and its emptiness in simultaneous awareness
Seal the realization within the boundary of the Dharmakaya

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The faculty of Prajna which translates experience into wisdom
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The resonance of Interdependence connecting all nodes of existence
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The law of Karma determining the timing of phenomenal ripening
phase_5.alfs_store: The Heart Sutra as the foundational logic for the emptiness operation

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system returns to its original state of emptiness through the realization that nothing was ever truly added or removed
